run_count_docs: run the script to count documents and average lines and tokens per document in a file
run_count_docs_gzip: run the script with the --gzip flag to count documents in a gzip compressed file
summarize_main: summarize the main function that parses arguments and counts documents separated by empty lines
review_gopen: review the gopen helper function that opens plain or gzip compressed input files
test_count_docs: test the script by running it on a sample file with documents separated by empty lines
